paragraphs.text: Kadena is a naga wizard , belonging to the Silumgar brood of Tarkir in the current timeline.

Clever, canny, and shrewd, Kadena is always looking for a chance to claw her way to power within the brood. She maintains a network of spies who keep her informed of everything happening within the ranks of power. This hoard of information is kept in preparation for the day when she throws off all pretense and seizes power for herself.
